basic_info.description: This incredible condo is nestled in a highly desirable complex, offering the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community. The updated flooring, renovated bath, and fresh satin paint create a bright and spacious living area everyone looks for. Take the elevator down or walk around the corner to shop at H Mart or dine at the many convenient options just steps away. Proximity to Lake Merced, Stonestown Galleria, Trader Joes, Whole Foods, Regal Cinemas, offers endless activities, entertainment and shopping options.  Your new home awaits! Come see the home today!
